description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ignis
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Overclock (0~2), removed after using Overclock two times

description.name: Overclock Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Overclock level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ignis]

description.name: Overclock Level
description.text: Keeps track of Overclock level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Ignis]
